findings.text: Lowered to an advisory as debt outside the change. This older test parses the stub's `recordArgsTo` file inline here and again at line 570, on lines this diff did not write. `recordedCalls` in tests/helpers/stub-git.ts now does the same parsing. The round 1 duplication defect is resolved: in the regenerated diff, both new test files import `recordedCalls`, `tracedCommands` and `commitsEachMaintained` from tests/helpers/stub-git.ts (diff.patch lines 148-175, 208, 345). The reviewer raised no finding in round 2.

Kept as an advisory. Under a whole revert, AC-13's red is a race: the commit's own detached maintenance may pack the objects before the assertions run. The test fails every time when only the runner's call is removed, so a test does fail on reversion of the behaviour. The round 1 AC-10 defect is resolved: the test now finds the paragraph that starts '- A `.git` that holds anything' and asserts it contains 'started by the runner after a commit, in the foreground' (diff.patch lines 544-549). The ADR's lines carrying that phrase are in the diff.
